name: Leanne Hyndman
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I work with adults living with the effects of crime, workplace injury and complex trauma, whether it happened recently or long ago. My practice, Riverbank Counselling, is in the Ringwood area, with sessions in person, online or by phone. I draw on EMDR, Narrative Therapy and expressive therapies, and work at the pace you set.

name: Kaye Griffin
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Welcome to Mind Matters Counselling Services. I specialise in providing intensive somatic trauma, grief and loss therapy and provide individual and group clinical supervision. Clients I work within trauma and trauma related issues (including addictions, attachment disorders, eating disorders, anxiety, and depression), death, dying, grief, loss, and crisis. I am also trained in: * EMDR I, II, Masterclass, Accredited EMDR Practitioner * Somatic Trauma Therapist – 100 hour training with Babette Rothschild * Animal Assisted Psychotherapist, Foundation, Advanced, Masterclass, Accredited AAP Supervisor * Brainspotting Consultant and Supervisor, Phase I, II, III, IV, Intensive, Masterclass I am a past Victorian Board Member for The Australian Association of Supervisors.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Bernadette Milsted
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I have been a professional counsellor and psychotherapist for over 25 years. I have lectured in tertiary counselling and welfare courses, developed and facilitated group therapy programs, managed a Christian counselling organisation, worked in counselling teams in general practice, in Palliative care, Dementia Care and private practice. My experience includes grief and loss, family, carer stress, couples and individual psychotherapy, PTSD, anxiety and trauma, life transitions and abuse.

name: Matthew Raker
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: As an accomplished Counsellor (PACFA) and Social Worker (AASW), I am passionate about creating authentic therapeutic relationships that empower individuals to overcome challenges and realise their full potential. With a rich academic background, including a Bachelor of Social Science (Criminal Justice), Graduate Diploma of Counselling, Master of Counselling & Psychotherapy, and a Master of Social Work (Qualifying) with merit, I bring a diverse skill set to my practice. I specialise in trauma-informed care, addressing issues such as PTSD, single incident/complex trauma, general and social anxiety, depression, grief and loss, phobias, personal and career development, assertiveness training, life direction/transition, confidence building, motivation, self-esteem, stress reduction, anger management, pain management, addiction, and relationship challenges.

name: Barry Laing
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I live in Preston, Melbourne, VIC with my partner and daughter. I completed a Masters degree in Gestalt therapy in 2018. As a counsellor and psychotherapist, I am passionate about developing dialogue with and support for people that affirms them in their experience, grows awareness, and fosters agency and change.
